seoDescription: Grades 1–9 start Aug. 23, 2027; grade 10 starts Aug. 24 and grades 11–12 Aug. 25. Spring Break runs Apr. 10–17; see delays, exams, and the official PDF.
heroSummary: Toledo Public Schools grades 1–9 start Monday, August 23, 2027; grade 10 reports August 24 and grades 11–12 report August 25. Preschool and kindergarten students phase in August 23–31, Early High School Opportunity (EHSO) starts August 31, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend September 1. The last student day is Friday, May 26, 2028.
heroSourceLine: 2027–28 school calendar dates · Reviewed against the BOE-adopted TPS calendar
calendarNotes: Grades 1–9 begin August 23, grade 10 begins August 24, and grades 11–12 begin August 25. Preschool and kindergarten students phase in August 23–31, EHSO starts August 31, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend September 1. October 15 and March 10 are K–8 two-hour delays on quarter-ending dates, while K–8 students do not attend during elementary conferences October 28–29. Spring Break runs through Monday, April 17, so classes resume Tuesday, April 18. High school exams are December 15–17 and May 24–26, with the final exam date also serving as the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Toledo Public Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–9 start August 23, 2027, grade 10 starts August 24, and grades 11–12 start August 25. EHSO starts August 31, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend September 1 after phase-in.

calendarFaqs.q: What does EHSO mean, and when does it start?
calendarFaqs.a: EHSO means Early High School Opportunity. Its first day is Tuesday, August 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Are TPS K–8 delay and conference dates days off?
calendarFaqs.a: The October 15 and March 10 quarter endings are two-hour delays for K–8, not days off. K–8 students do not attend during the October 28–29 elementary parent-teacher conferences; the district calendar does not say high schools are closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When are TPS Thanksgiving and Winter Breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26, 2027, with classes resuming November 29. Winter Break runs December 21, 2027–January 3, 2028; January 4 is a teacher inservice day, so students return January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is TPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: TPS Spring Break runs Monday, April 10 through Monday, April 17, 2028. Students return Tuesday, April 18.
